The tool functions similar to an event driven architecture. It has several remarkable capabilities. However it's use is limited to selected public LLM models. Although it supports Ollama, this would require a local hosting of the model. The Ollama feature is also in experimental stage. The final option for users is to use a model hosted on Azure, thus limiting users to a specific cloud provider.
